Title: The new Power BI filter pane goes live in all reports

Body.Content:
The new filter pane goes live in all reports in April 2020. Turn it on now to fine-tune the formatting in your reports before then.

 

The new filter pane allows you to format the filters pane to match the look and feel of your report. You can format the filters pane differently for each page in the report.

 

You can now modify the default settings of the filter pane with a theme file. Read Use Report Themes in Power BI Desktop article to learn more.

For Power BI Embedded, you can use the client JavaScript API to modify the report theme, and thus modify the new filter pane formatting. Read Apply report themes using JavaScript API to learn more.

If you wish to retain the old dark theme, use this theme Json that changes the filter pane formatting to dark theme.

Read the following articles to learn more:

Use Report Themes in Power BI Desktop

Apply report themes using JavaScript API
